full_text_tesim: Originally belonged together with the following
Sayings of SS. Macarius, John Carpatheus, Isaac of Nineveh and Gregory Nazienzis

The original manuscript was restored around the 10th century in the Melkite milieu where it was supplied not only with the missing text of the Psalter but also with Horologion according to the Syriac Chalcedonian rite. The same Melkite hand also overwritten the faded text in the extant part of the manuscript.
The quire signatures are marked in the bottom margin of the last folio; a later hand provided the quire signatures in Georgian that run backwards
